Name: Tandem Walk
Why added: Traveling heel-to-toe gait materially narrows the base of support and demands precise foot placement.

Name: Side Shuffle
Why added: Continuous lateral acceleration and deceleration in an athletic stance add quiet frontal-plane conditioning.

Name: Backward Walking
Why added: Backward initiation, clearance, and weight acceptance add a genuinely absent direction of gait.

Name: Walking with Horizontal Head Turns
Why added: Head turns create a meaningful self-generated visual and vestibular disturbance while gait continues.

Name: Hula Kāholo
Why added: Side-close-side-tap weight transfer in a sustained bent-knee stance adds lateral gait skill and leg endurance.

Name: Bhangra Chaal
Why added: Large alternating knee and heel actions with overhead arm coordination make a vigorous whole-body round.

Name: Samba no Pé Basic
Why added: Continuous syncopated triple-foot action and weight transfer provide compact whole-body conditioning.

Name: Low-Impact Skater Step
Why added: Wide alternating lateral steps and a low stance create systemic effort without a jump or flight phase.

Name: High-Knee March
Why added: Reciprocal knee drive and contralateral arm action provide a quiet running-mechanics and endurance drill.

Name: Wing Chun Juen Ma Turning Stance
Why added: Repeated left-centre-right weight shifts and stance pivots train controlled turning and lower-body endurance.
